scope: One policy and shared packet-indexed random streams per directed link for all packet types; independent reverse direction. Packet-type labels are diagnostic only.

user_approval.scope: Update existing P8 tests that assumed traffic-class policies and adjust set_link call sites

checks.new_independent_staged_checks: 3 additional mixed-packet checks passed before updating the approved existing tests; their cases are covered by the revised permanent relay tests

older_test_sources.note: Original pre-P8 test/fixture hashes; the two P8 test files were changed under explicit approval.

test_changes: Control and data now share loss with an independently usable reverse direction.
Delay and duplication checks now cover both packet types under the same policy.
A full outage drops queued control and data packets at delivery.
Seed independence is per directed link; changing packet types preserves the same seeded decisions.
Traffic-class argument removed from affected process-test calls.
Replaced data-only-loss process case with all-traffic outage: data and cleanup are dropped; removal remains Pending; restoring before the original cutoff allows the original removal to complete.
Existing partitioned-removal case still observes Unresolved at cutoff and retains that evidence through teardown.
exploratory_checks: A draft recovery test assumed restoring connectivity would restart an expired removal. It remained Unresolved, consistent with the fixed-cutoff contract.
A fresh-removal draft completed edge cleanup but a fifth original admission to one host received CoAP 5.03; the configured response-cache bound is four.

A variant creating the binding with the receiver and using a one-second fresh-removal allowance observed Unresolved. No progress bound was established for that schedule; this policy change does not alter core retry scheduling.
The final test isolates directed-link behavior by restoring connectivity within the existing five-second cleanup allowance and keeping the original exchange and operation ID.
historical_record: p8_verification.json and its original logs remain unchanged; its class-specific-policy results describe the earlier implementation.
limits: Host UDP/sanitizer checks only; no C changes, hardware run, new timing guarantees, or formal qualification. Stochastic packets share a policy, not necessarily the same individual outcome.
